prompts.tree_oak_v1: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent cutout for the fixed-camera children's 3D farm game Elektro-stol. Create ONE beautiful mature small oak tree, entire crown and trunk fully visible, isolated on a genuinely transparent background. Camera: orthographic three-quarter overhead view, approximately 45 degrees elevation; tree upright, trunk base centered near bottom with safe transparent margins. Style: premium handcrafted miniature farm diorama, softly sculpted rounded shapes, subtly painted realistic toy material, charming but not childish clip art. Existing game uses realistic stylized farm animal figurines and a red wooden barn, warm cream, teal and coral props. Tree foliage: attractive asymmetric lobed canopy with a few large readable masses plus restrained medium leaf clusters, rich natural sage/olive greens, warm yellow-green upper highlights and forest-green undersides, varied foliage shapes, never fluorescent lime, not a pile of smooth spheres. Visible warm walnut trunk and a few stout branches. Soft ambient studio illumination with upper-left key, gentle dimensional self-shading. Clean silhouette readable at 150px tall, no intricate noisy leaves. No ground, no soil mound, no grass base, no cast shadow on a ground plane, no planter, no animals, no buildings, no wires, no text, no border. Single tree only, no multiple views, no layout sheet. The output will be used as a lightweight in-game tree decoration; preserve authentic alpha outside the tree.
prompts.grass: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square diffuse/albedo ground texture for a premium children's miniature farm game, to tile unobtrusively across a large ground plane. Primary request: a beautiful quiet natural meadow turf surface seen in exact orthographic top-down view, filling the entire square edge to edge. Hand-painted sculpted toy-diorama art style, broad subtle moss/sage/olive green variations with restrained stylized grass brushwork, small soft organic clumps suggesting healthy short grass. Medium muted sage green, not neon lime, not dark forest. Low contrast and visual calm so 3D toy animals, cream circuit boards, electrical wires, and paths will remain distinct over it. Extremely sparse tiny warm straw hints, no flowers. Seamlessly repeating edges, evenly distributed detail and illumination, no directional light or shadows baked in, no perspective. No trees, no bushes, no rocks, no roads, no fences, no buildings, no animals, no isolated objects, no border, no text, no frame, no UI, no grid. It must be one homogeneous usable game material rather than a landscape or an illustrated scene. Soft premium tactile painted texture, not photographic grass, no large recognizable repeat landmarks.
prompts.grass_light: Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: seamless game ground texture, a lighter meadow variant for the farm hill. Edit this reference grass texture only: preserve its top-down view, hand-painted style, grass scale, calm contrast, homogeneous coverage and edge repeat continuity. Make the grass gently lighter and slightly warmer than the source, a soft silvery sage with restrained straw-green highlights. Not neon, not washed out, not yellow. Keep even ambient illumination with no directional light or shadows. No new objects, flowers, paths, borders, text or perspective. Full square texture edge to edge, intended for seamless tiling.
prompts.path: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square ground material for a beautiful children's toy farm game. Generate a top-down orthographic albedo texture of a well-trodden pale warm ochre earth farm lane. Entire image is the same walkable dirt surface, edge to edge, no grass borders or defined road shape: the game will clip this material to curved paths. A subtle natural mixture of compacted warm sand and fine earth with a few tiny softly rounded pebbles, slight organic variations, shallow smooth impressions suggesting use. Premium hand-painted miniature diorama aesthetic matching sculpted toy animals and a red wooden barn, calm readable shapes, tactile and inviting. Medium light biscuit and warm muted tan palette, not orange, not gray, not muddy. Subtle low contrast, not noisy; broad color uniformity, no large patches, dark cracks, holes, dramatic shadows or sharp bright highlights. Uniform ambient illumination; no perspective, no directional shadow. Seamless repeat on all four edges. No objects, footprints, tire tracks, plants, grass, flowers, fences, buildings, text, borders, UI or grid. A single game-ready texture material, not a landscape illustration.
prompts.soil: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless 512px game tile source for the plowed field of a charming children's miniature farm. Exact orthographic top-down view of warm medium brown cultivated earth with evenly spaced soft parallel furrows, all running vertically from the upper edge to the lower edge. Each furrow has gently uneven hand-shaped edges and fine earthy clods, subtle low-relief self shading only. Premium softly sculpted and hand-painted toy diorama material. Eight or so narrow parallel furrows across the square, without any perspective or converging lines. Full image edge-to-edge earth, all four edges must repeat seamlessly with the same furrow spacing. Warm umber and muted terracotta earth, medium contrast that reads at small scale, no harsh black gaps. Neutral even ambient illumination, no directional cast shadows or highlights. No plants, seeds, grass, stones, objects, tools, fences, border, text or grid. Not realistic muddy photography, not a scene. One usable tileable soil surface.
prompts.mud: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square diffuse texture for the pig pen ground in a premium children's miniature farm game. Exact orthographic top-down view. Soft smooth damp brown earth with a few gentle pressed rounded patches and very sparse tiny soft clods, inviting toy-clay appearance, not filthy or gross. Muted chocolate and warm taupe brown, medium darkness, very low contrast. Entire square edge to edge same moist mud material, uniform ambient illumination, no wet shine, reflections, directional shadows, holes, cracks, large stones or big landmarks. Premium softly hand-painted diorama material matching stylized toy farm animals. Edges seamlessly tile in both directions with no visible square, border or central island. No water puddles, no footprints, no hoof tracks, no grass, no plants, no animals, no objects, no scene, no text, no perspective. Quiet game ground texture that does not distract from a pink pig on top.
prompts.pond_bed: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square pond-floor diffuse texture for a premium children's miniature toy farm game. Exact orthographic top-down view of fine pale sandy pond bottom, a few very small smoothly rounded river pebbles barely emerging, faint gentle silt variations. Soft painted sculpted miniature-diorama aesthetic, warm cream sand and muted beige with a tiny cool sage tint; low contrast, quiet surface. This is the dry albedo of the pond bottom BEFORE any water shader is applied: no blue water, no ripples, caustics, waves, reflections, specular highlights, shore line or aquatic plants. Fill the entire square edge-to-edge with homogeneous fine sand, no perspective, no directional lighting or cast shadows, seamless repeated edges in both directions. No objects, animals, fish, plants, grass, text, borders, frame or grid. Simple natural tactile texture, not busy photorealistic gravel.
